summary: Iteration 12 e2e test. Backend: 12/12 pytest passing covering market/nearby (+ city/type filter), market/contribute, aadhaar initiate+confirm (self and tenant), tenant list reflects aadhaar_verified/aadhaar_last_4, will/send-for-lawyer-review + public/will-review/{token} GET & submit, will/invite-witness + public/witness-sign/{token} GET & POST, will/notify-beneficiaries, plus regression on demo-login + properties list (4 demo props) + /api/calc/emi. Frontend: demo login OK (redirects to /app), Properties renders 4 NearbyMarketCards correctly, Aadhaar modal flow completes and UI shows 'Aadhaar verified ****1234' toast + badge, Will page exposes will-send-lawyer, witness-invite, will-notify testids. Public routes /lawyer-review/:token and /witness-sign/:token mount and show proper 'Invalid link' error states for bad tokens.

minor.issue: Review request mentioned params {locality, property_type} but actual API uses {area, type, bhk}. Not a bug but doc mismatch.
Review request mentioned body {tenant_id, phone, aadhaar_last_4}; actual schema requires {subject_type, subject_id, aadhaar_last_4, phone, name}. Works, just a contract-doc mismatch.

ui_bugs.issue: First-time demo users see an onboarding tour overlay ('Step 1 · Add your first property') that intercepts clicks on the Verify Aadhaar button on /app/tenants. Need to click 'Skip tour' first. Consider auto-dismissing tour on non-dashboard routes or raising aadhaar-modal z-index above the tour.

When token is invalid, page renders 'Invalid link' but the outer wrapper data-testid (lawyer-review / witness-sign) is not present on the error-state branch; tests can only verify by text. Low priority.

action_items: (Optional) Dismiss onboarding tour automatically when navigating to /app/tenants, /app/will, /app/properties, or raise z-index of sub-page modals above the tour overlay so tour doesn't block Aadhaar / other flows.
(Optional) Keep data-testid wrapper on LawyerReview / WitnessSign in the error/invalid-token branch for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is ~4805 lines — flagged for modularization (exceeds 700-line guideline). Split into routers per domain (market.py, verify.py, will.py, etc.).
/api/market/contribute accepts user-submitted data with no rate-limit / dedupe — community data could be polluted; add per-user submission caps.

/api/public/will-review/{token} and /api/public/witness-sign/{token} never check expires_at vs current time before returning content — expired tokens (30-day TTL is set but not enforced on GET) still load the Will. Recommend reject when datetime.fromisoformat(r['expires_at']) < now.
Aadhaar stub accepts ANY 6-digit OTP — correctly stubbed but ensure log line makes this explicit and mode='stub' is surfaced in prod config checks.
notify_beneficiaries generates+password-protects PDF per beneficiary but doesn't attach it to the email stub — in production the Resend call must attach pdf_bytes.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests insert a TEST_Tenant_Aadhaar tenant (phone 9876543210) on the first demo-user property, plus minimal Will payload for demo user and a 'TestCity / TEST_area' market contribution row. No explicit cleanup — safe because demo user is wiped on next demo-login or scoped to demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo user app routes are under /app/<page> (not /<page>). Onboarding tour intercepts clicks on /app pages for new demo sessions — dismiss via 'Skip tour' text before interacting with page buttons. Aadhaar stub OTP accepts ANY 6 digits (not a fixed 123456). Public Will review endpoint is /api/public/will-review/{token} (not /api/public/lawyer-review/{token}). Will schema expects witness_1/witness_2 as plain strings. Tenant create requires property_id. All iteration-12 backend endpoints responded 200 under demo session.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues. Two minor MVP-readiness items: (1) onboarding tour blocks sub-page buttons for new sessions; (2) expires_at on lawyer-review / witness-sign tokens is stored but not enforced on GET.
